newsitem.title: USA: Nebraska fed cattle market inactive - private.
newsitem.headline: Nebraska fed cattle market inactive - private.

text.p: Nebraska feedlot cattle trade near midday Monday was inactive, with no reported sales or bids, market sources said.
Owners priced cattle at $104.00 to $105.00 per cwt on a dressed and $65.00 on a live basis.
Sales last week ranged at top prices of $100.00 to $102.00, with most at $101.00, including sales late Friday. Sales on a live basis ranged $62.00 to $63.00, with a few at $64.00.
The showlist was estimated near 88,000 head, up 1,000 from last week, sources said.
